title.narrative: Make People Stronger: Validating the market for Respectful Farewell services in Uganda

description.narrative: Proper morgue facilities are not widely available in Uganda. Burials are however considered culturally highly important – families spend an average of €2,000-5,000 on a typical burial. Due to climatic circumstances, there is a time constraint to burials, even though the more affluent members of a given family tend to live abroad. Extending the time between the actual death and burial increases the chance for the expatriate family member to be able to attend the funeral. This is a market that is currently under-serviced, despite the clear demand.Dutch Social Enterprise Make People Stronger (MPS) wants to service this market by opening several cooled morgue facilities across the country that will enable respectful and hygienic burial services and extended time between death and burial ceremonies. Furthermore, through its business model, MPS wants to use its profits to support local hospitals and charitable organisations. To prepare for future investments, Technical Assistance provided support to validate the market and develop a bankable business plan. The validation has been successful and further investments in 3 new morgue facilities with local hospitals in Uganda are prepared. This is likely to result in 20 jobs per morgue, with a special focus on attracting female employees as part of MPS’s strategy to empower women. Furthermore these investments will contribute to sustainable transfer of knowledge and improve burial services for families dealing with losing their loved ones.
